## News Releases


Immunic to Participate in Investor Conferences in November


- Print Page


- Email Page

NEW YORK


, Nov. 2, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Immunic, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810931-1&h=3391957666&u=https%3A%2F%2Fimux.com%2F&a=Immunic%2C+Inc.) **(Nasdaq: IMUX),** a late-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of novel oral therapies for neurologic diseases, today announced participation in the following investor conferences in November:


- November 9-11: **Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference.** Erik Lundgren, Chief Executive Officer, and Jason Tardio, President and Chief Operating Officer, will participate in a fireside chat on Monday, November 9, 2026 at 1:00 pm ET at this conference in Boston. A webcast will be available on the "Events and Presentations" section of Immunic's website at:[https://ir.imux.com/events-and-presentations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810931-1&h=997013870&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.imux.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.imux.com%2Fevents-and-presentations) .


Mr. Lundgren, Mr. Tardio, and Jessica Breu, Vice President Investor Relations and Communications at Immunic, will also participate in one-on-one investor meetings at the conference. To schedule a meeting, please contact your Guggenheim representative or Jessica Breu at:jessica.breu@imux.com .


- November 10-12: **Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference.** Mr. Lundgren and Mr. Tardio will participate in a fireside chat on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 2:00 pm ET at this conference in New York. A webcast will be available on the "Events and Presentations" section of Immunic's website at:[https://ir.imux.com/events-and-presentations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810931-1&h=997013870&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.imux.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.imux.com%2Fevents-and-presentations) .


Mr. Lundgren, Mr. Tardio, and Mrs. Breu will also participate in one-on-one investor meetings at the conference. To schedule a meeting, please contact your Stifel representative or Jessica Breu at:jessica.breu@imux.com .


- November 17-18: Mr. Lundgren, Mr. Tardio, and Patrick Walsh, Chief Business Officer, will be hosting one-on-one meetings in London in connection with the **Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference** . To schedule a meeting, please contact Jessica Breu at:jessica.breu@imux.com .


Additionally, Immunic will host a **Virtual Progressive Multiple Sclerosis R&D Day** on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 12:30 pm ET with management and two renowned experts in the treatment of multiple sclerosis (MS) and development of new therapies, Jiwon Oh, M.D., Ph.D., FRCPC, Division of Neurology, University of Toronto, and Maria Pia Sormani, Ph.D., University of Genoa, Italy. The group will discuss the key unmet needs in progressive MS and the persistent needs for innovative approaches to the development of therapies that target novel mechanisms associated with neurodegeneration and MS progression. Register[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810931-1&h=3144142591&u=https%3A%2F%2Fimux.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_7bmvMzdSRgurYwCsxCmWEw%23%2Fregistration&a=here) to attend.


**About Immunic, Inc.** Immunic, Inc. (Nasdaq: IMUX) is a late-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of novel oral therapies for neurologic diseases. The company's lead investigational asset, vidofludimus calcium (IMU-838), is currently being evaluated in Phase 3 clinical trials in relapsing multiple sclerosis, with top-line data expected to be available by the end of 2026. Initiation of an additional Phase 3 clinical trial in progressive multiple sclerosis is expected later in 2026. Vidofludimus calcium combines potential neuroprotective effects associated with nuclear receptor-related 1 (Nurr1) activation with anti-inflammatory and anti-viral effects associated with selective inhibition of the enzyme dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (DHODH). The company's development pipeline also includes earlier-stage programs, including IMU-381 and IMU-856, aimed at building a broader therapeutics platform addressing neurodegenerative and autoimmune diseases. For further information, please visit:[www.imux.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810931-1&h=895209498&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4749110-1%26h%3D1696902628%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.imux.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.imux.com&a=www.imux.com) .
